Known biology provided

Synthetic example. Peaks from chronically stimulated (exhausted-like) CD8 T cells. Exhaustion is driven by TOX and NR4A family factors downstream of persistent TCR/NFAT signalling, while TCF1 (Tcf7) marks the progenitor-exhausted subset. We want to know which pathways and transcription factors these peaks point to.

Expected genes: Tox, Pdcd1, Havcr2, Entpd1, Tcf7, Cd160

Expected TFs: Nfatc1, Nr4a1, Batf, Tcf7

  • 22% of peaks are promoter-proximal and 78% distal [E2].

  • go_bp hub genes shared across top pathways: Bcl6, Ccr7, Ifng, Lef1, Tbx21, Batf, Ctla4, Eomes, Il21, Il7r [E4].

Methods

Peaks were filtered to standard chromosomes, de-duplicated. Peaks were annotated with ChIPpeakAnno (v3.36.1) against TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene gene models: each peak was assigned its nearest gene by TSS distance, and all genes whose TSS window (-2000/+500 bp) overlapped the peak were recorded as promoter targets. Genomic-region distribution used assignChromosomeRegion and the TSS profile used binOverFeature. Over-representation of peak-linked genes was tested with clusterProfiler (v4.10.1) (GO via org.*.eg.db, KEGG, ReactomePA (v1.46.0), MSigDB via msigdbr (v10.0.2)) against all annotated genes as background, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Known-motif enrichment used monaLisa (v1.8.1) with JASPAR2020 CORE vertebrate PWMs on 200 bp windows centred on peaks, against a GC-matched random genomic background. Overlap with public ChIP-seq/ATAC-seq experiments was tested with ChIP-Atlas Enrichment Analysis (random-permutation background, Fisher's exact test, BH-adjusted). Differentially expressed genes were intersected with peak-linked genes; enrichment was assessed with a hypergeometric test over all tested genes. Related literature was retrieved from Europe PMC and related datasets from NCBI GEO.
